name: Flash Fire in Central Town

npcs.name: Rico Dela Cruz
dialogue: A cooking fire has spread to the market stalls, and thick smoke is crossing the street.
Warn the vendors and take the clear exit away from the smoke.
after_dialogue: Everyone is out of the market. Do not go back inside for bags or belongings.

choice.prompt: Smoke is spreading through the street. Which exit is safer?

options.text: Use the clear route away from smoke
options.result: The group leaves by the clear route.
options.consequence: You moved away from smoke and fire.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.result: Smoke can overwhelm people quickly and hide exits.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

npcs.name: Aling Rosa
dialogue: I am near the clinic, but smoke is making it hard to breathe.
Please bring the spare respirator. I will leave by the clear route with you.
after_dialogue: I have the respirator. I can follow you to the safe area now.
rescue_dialogue: I am stranded and need spare respirator. Please bring it, then help me get to the safe route, away from smoke and ash.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. I can follow you to the safe route, away from smoke and ash now.
npcs.rescue_hint: Find spare respirator, then speak with Aling Rosa again.

items.name: Recover the scorched machine component if the route is safe

quests.title: Rescue Aling Rosa with the respirator
Check in with Rico Dela Cruz
Find a battery radio for official fire evacuation updates.
Recover the scorched machine component if the route is safe

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.rescue_kit: Search the clear route for a spare respirator before attempting the rescue.
quests.rescue_neighbor: Find Aling Rosa and speak with her after collecting the spare respirator.
quests.community: Find Rico Dela Cruz and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach Fire Safe Zone and stay clear of danger.

lessons: Use the planned safe exit and go to the family or community meeting place.
Stay with your group and tell responders if someone is missing.
Do not return to a fire-affected building until authorities say it is safe.

quiz.question: Smoke blocks your usual exit during a fire. What should you do?
options: Use a planned alternate safe exit and meet at the designated point
Hide in a room and wait without telling anyone
Go back inside after reaching safety to collect supplies
quiz.explanation: Know alternate escape routes and a meeting place. Do not re-enter until authorities say it is safe.

briefing: A fire spreads through a dense commercial district. Raise the alarm, guide residents away from smoke, electrical hazards, and fuel containers, and use a safe alternate exit. Do not enter a burning building to attempt an untrained rescue.
story_clue: The scorched component has the same maker’s mark as the earlier research equipment.
